GrantUserPermission.summary: Grants role-based access control (RBAC) permissions to Resource Access Management (RAM) users or RAM roles. System policies can be attached to RAM users to grant only the operation permissions on Distributed Cloud Container Platform for Kubernetes (ACK One) cluster resources. The operation permissions include creating and viewing instances. If you want to perform operations on Kubernetes resources in a specific cluster by using a RAM user or assuming a RAM role, such as creating GitOps applications and Argo workflows, you must grant RBAC permissions to the RAM user or RAM role to perform operations on the specified ACK One cluster and namespace. This topic describes how to grant RBAC permissions to a RAM user or RAM role.

schema.description:
The authorization type. Valid values:

*   cluster: The permissions are granted to a cluster.
*   namespace: The permissions are granted to a namespace of a cluster.

The predefined role. Valid values:

*   admin: administrator
*   dev: developer
*   gitops-dev: GitOps developer. The parameter is available only for Fleet instances.

The value of RoleName and that of RoleType must meet the following requirements:

*   If **RoleType** is set to **cluster**, this parameter must be set to **admin**.
*   If **RoleType** is set to **namespace**, this parameter must be set to **dev** or **gitops-dev**.
The cluster ID.

The name of the namespace.

*   If **RoleType** is set to **cluster**, you do not need to specify this parameter.
*   This parameter is required if **RoleType** is set to **namespace**.
*   If **RoleType** is set to **namespace** and **RoleName** is set to **gitops-dev**, this parameter is required and must be set to **argocd**.
The ID of the RAM user or RAM role.

The entity to which the permissions are granted. A value of `true` indicates that the permissions are granted to a RAM user. A value of `false` indicates that the permissions are granted to a RAM role.

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Schema of Response

GrantUserPermission.title: GrantUserPermission
GrantUserPermission.description:
*   To call this API operation to grant permissions to a RAM user or RAM role on a specific cluster, you must use an Alibaba Cloud account, the account that is used to create the cluster, or a RAM user that has the cluster administrator permissions. A regular RAM user does not have the permissions to call this operation.
*   Before you grant RBAC permissions to a RAM user or RAM role on a cluster, you must grant the operation permissions to the RAM user or RAM role on the specified cluster. For more information, see [Attach a system permission policy to a RAM user or RAM role](~~613486~~).

For more information, see [Authorization overview](~~613468~~).

The fleet name. The name must be 1 to 63 characters long and must start with a letter. It can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

Specifies whether to enable audit logs.

- true: enables audit logs.

- false: disables audit logs.

Specifies whether to enable Service Mesh (ASM).

- true: enables Service Mesh.

- false: disables Service Mesh.

The deletion protection attribute of the cluster. This attribute specifies whether you can delete the cluster in the console or by calling the [DeleteHubCluster](~~424406~~) operation.

- true: enables deletion protection.

- false: disables deletion protection.

Default value: false.

Specifies whether to expose the API server to the Internet.

- true: Associates an elastic IP address (EIP) with the API server. You can specify the ApiServerEipId parameter. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically creates an EIP.

- false: Disassociates the EIP from the API server.
The EIP instance ID.

Specifies whether to enable ArgoCD. This parameter takes effect only when Profile is set to XFlow. To view the profile, call the [DescribeHubClusterDetails](~~424405~~) operation.

Valid values:

- true: enables ArgoCD.

- false: disables ArgoCD.

Specifies whether to enable the UI for workflow instances. This parameter takes effect only when Profile is set to XFlow. To view the profile, call the [DescribeHubClusterDetails](~~424405~~) operation.

Valid values:

- true: enables the UI.

- false: disables the UI.

The workflow scheduling mode. This parameter takes effect only when Profile is set to XFlow. To view the profile, call the [DescribeHubClusterDetails](~~424405~~) operation.

Valid values:

- cost-optimized: The cost-optimized mode is used.

- stock-optimized: The stock-optimized mode is used.
The price limit for the workflow payload. This parameter takes effect only when WorkflowScheduleMode is set to cost-optimized.
The list of vSwitches.

items.description: The vSwitch ID.

schema.description:
Specifies whether to enable the monitoring dashboard for workflow instances. This parameter applies only if Profile is set to XFlow. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.

- false: Disabled.

Specifies whether to enable high availability (HA) for ArgoCD. Valid values:

- true: Enables HA.

- false: Disables HA.

Specifies whether to enable public domain name resolution for the ArgoCD or Argo Workflow console. Valid values:

- true: Enables public domain name resolution.

- false: Disables public domain name resolution.

items.description: The CIDR block that is denied access to the Argo server from the internet. Example: 192.168.1.0/24.

schema.description: The public network access control list (ACL). This parameter takes effect only when PublicAccessEnabled is set to true.

Specifies whether ArgoEvents is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.

- false: Disabled.

Specifies whether to enable the Gateway feature. Valid values:

- true: Enables the Gateway feature.

- false: Disables the Gateway feature.

Specifies if orchestration is enabled for machine learning training tasks. Valid values:

- true: Orchestration is enabled.

- false: Orchestration is disabled.

Whether to enable the Cost Insight feature. Valid values are as follows:

- true: The feature is enabled.

- false: The feature is disabled.
Specifies whether to enable RAM Roles for Service Accounts (RRSA).
Specifies whether to enable the Spark Operator.
Specifies whether to enable KubeRay.

UpdateUserPermission.summary: Updates the role-based access control (RBAC) permissions of a RAM user.

schema.description:
The authorization type. Valid values:

*   cluster: specifies that the permissions are scoped to a master instance.
*   namespace: specifies that the permissions are scoped to a namespace of a cluster.

The predefined role. Valid values:

*   admin: administrator
*   dev: developer
The ID of the master instance.
The namespace to which the permissions are scoped. By default, this parameter is empty when you set RoleType to cluster.
The ID of the RAM user.
